instruction: Candid full-body photograph of a couple by a white wall and black fence. The woman in the white long-sleeved dress (R1) stands on the left, leaning against the wall and looking up with a smile. The man in the patterned short-sleeved shirt (R2) stands on the right, wrapping his arms around her upper body from the side. Bright daylight casts soft shadows on the wall.
